sources.quote: About 80% of people detained since Trump retook office have come from the interior of the country, where they are much more likely to have community ties
sources.searcher_note: Post-cutoff: interior detentions ~80% under Trump II vs 30% in Biden's last two years; 610,000+ detained. Measures interior origin, not arrival year. Live page is behind a Cloudflare bot wall; quote verified on the Internet Archive copy (20260915184905).

sources.quote: The number of daily detention beds holding people arrested in the interior of the United States quadrupled over the course of 2025, increasing from a daily average of around 14,000 in the second half of 2024
sources.searcher_note: Interior-arrest detentions roughly 4x from late 2024 to Jan 2026; also notes July 2025 bond policy applied regardless of years lived in the U.S. No entry-year breakdown.

sources.quote: every week thousands of long-time residents continue to be arrested and thrown into detention centers despite lengthy ties to American communities and no criminal records
sources.searcher_note: Advocacy group reading of Deportation Data Project release: long-time residents detained weekly; no count, no entry-year definition, no comparison year

sources.outlet: NYC Mayor's Office of Immigrant Affairs
sources.quote: There has been a 334% spike in ICE arrests of long-term U.S. residents with no criminal convictions in NYC.
sources.searcher_note: Earlier pattern, same measure family: ICE arrests of 10+ year non-criminal residents in the NYC area rose 334% Feb 2017-Jan 2018 vs prior year. Different place and window. Date is 'Updated January 2019' (day unknown).

notes: No source found that counts detentions by arrival year (arrived by 2021, or 10+ years in the U.S.) for 2026, or states the 13,265 / 3,490 / 3.8x figures, the ICE stay 3,083 to 11,567 Jan-Feb figures, or the 5,760 vs 3,076 10+ year comparison. Coverage found is on the adjacent pattern: detentions from the interior (Marshall Project, Deportation Data Project) and advocacy statements that long-time residents are being detained. No source disagreeing with the direction was found. Stateline (2025-12-12) blocked the fetch and showed no years-in-US sentence in the curl copy, so not recorded. TRAC (2026-06-26) and Vera (2026-04-10) pages checked, no entry-date findings.
